notes.title: A new Supercross patch released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910068/180cd32fa242b62bbf925a099b520003ff882c3c.jpg[/img]

Hi guys, in the last days we have worked a lot on Supercross and, thanks to your reports, we improved the game, fixing some problems such as some performance issues during late stages of races.
These are the updates of this new patch, let us know what you think:


-Improved overall stability

-Improved performance

-Fixed race time precision

-Minor fixes

notes.title: New patch just rolled out!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910068/df97ce373b62eb70d90c42882bbd557e7d7dda79.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, we keep having a great fun with Supercross The Game. That's why we also keep supporting it with new updates. Today's patch is all about the much loved soft barriers on the side of the tracks. They'll now respawn faster and more efficiently. We also included some minor fixes.

Keep crossing hard and keep sharing your great screenshots here on Steam!

notes.title: Major update out
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910068/fa99609acdc77f981bb35d7e01d4f1c7be463bfa.jpg[/img]

A new, major patch is being rolled out right now. First of all, thanks for bearing with us. You've been loud and clear and be assured that we read every single feedback sent in the last few weeks. Today, we're releasing a major update based on some of that feedback. We're not done with Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame, though, in the very (very!) near future, we'll be releasing the new Compound DLC and we'll keep listening to your comments and answering your questions where possible.

- New search by name option for online tracks
- Now you can change the livery of your bike in Career mode
- Added favourite and like buttons at the end of a race on online tracks
- Increased number of favourite tracks (up to 100)
- Added "mute all" option in multiplayer
- Faster repositioning of soft barriers during online races
- Fixed race results logic
- Fixed qualifying results to show correct destination heat
- Fixed AI and players collisions during online qualifications
- Fixed O'Neal logo graphic
- Fixed "King of Multiplayer" Challenge logic
- Fixed wrong engine sound after a pit stop
- Fixed image correction menu wrong values when accessing profile statistics from there
- Game options available in Online Lobby
- Startup movies are not skippable anymore
- Fixed Compound pause back button
- Fixed Compound SX and MX loading images
- Fixed Compound wood bridge sound
- Fixed Compound time attack and race triggers graphics
- Fixed Compound collision sounds

We're waiting to hear what you think!

notes.title: New patch online and servers status
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910068/fa99609acdc77f981bb35d7e01d4f1c7be463bfa.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone, a new patch is online, here is the fixlist.

Fixed Dirt on Boots during Main Menu and Customization
Improved AI behavior in Custom Tracks
Fixed an UI loop when leaving Career Mode
Fixed an issue that caused 450cc bikes to be usable in 250cc Career Mode
Fixed Result screens in Multiplayer Mode
Fixed Audio in Cutscenes
Fixed sandbag respawn in Online Multiplayer
Fixed Lap time for Clients on Official Tracks in Multiplayer Mode
Removed Props Posing in Track Editor
Fixed gates opening before initial countdown in Multiplayer mode
Fixed Chaz Braden’s bike

Regarding the servers situation, we are working around the clock to bring the situation back to normal, and we regret the inconveniences. Services are now back up, but we expect a number of disconnections during the weekend while we keep working. Please keep reporting while we keep the pressure hard on the issue in order to have everyone playing happily as soon as possible.
Thank you for bearing with us.

notes.title: Welcome to Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910068/030d1a5593fc04d9cb0da3cbad11683ae2cc49fe.jpg[/img][h1]Hello Everyone and welcome to the Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame Steam Page![/h1]

We will take you to the greatest supercross show and we want you to be part of it! [b]Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame[/b] will give you the opportunity to take part in the most competitive and high profile off-road motorcycle racing championship in the world.  Featuring innovative track design and set within prestigious stadiums, this is [b]the most realistic and immersive Supercross fan experience ever[/b].
Key features of tge game will be:
•	The official 2017 Monster Energy Supercross season with special Monster Energy Cup access.
•	Official bikes, iconic tracks, and athletes from both 250SX and 450SX Classes: Chad Reed, Ken Roczen, reigning champion Ryan Dungey and others will race across official challenging tracks.
•	An exciting career mode with extreme customization options: Customize both riders and bikes for the maximum flexibility to advance in racing classes.
•	A powerful track editor, for endless gameplay possibilities: Players can create, customize and share online their own tracks.
•	Top notch graphics for a world-class game quality and a next-level immersive experience:  accurate reproduction of bikes, tracks, accessories and athletes’ aspects. 

In order to stay update, here are some useful links:
Official Website: www.supercrossthegame.com
Facebook: facebook.com/SupercrossTheGame  
Instagram: Instagram.com/supercrossthegame 
Hashtag: #supercrossthegame
